findings.issue: Tense mismatch: jp 受ける is non-past (dictionary form, as expl itself states) and pt uses present ('recebo'), but en is past tense, breaking jp/en/pt consistency.
findings.current: I was treated in that way.

findings.issue: Token list has glossless fragments 子ども and たち AND a merged duplicate token 子どもたち, so concatenated surfaces no longer equal jp (子どもたち appears twice). Every other sentence in the batch tokenizes each surface exactly once.
findings.current: tokens: 子ども(all null) + たち(all null) + 子どもたち('the children')
findings.suggested: Remove the two null fragment tokens 子ども and たち; keep only the merged 子どもたち token

findings.issue: １冊 is read いっさつ (sokuon), not いちさつ; kana teaches a wrong reading of the counter.
findings.current: わたしわせんじつひさしぶりにいちさつのほんをよみました
findings.suggested: わたしわせんじつひさしぶりにいっさつのほんをよみました

findings.issue: Romaji mirrors the wrong kana: 1冊 is issatsu, not ichisatsu.
Token １ before 冊 must carry the geminated reading いっ (１冊 = いっさつ); いち is wrong in this context.
１杯 is read いっぱい, not いちばい (1杯=いっぱい, 2杯=にはい, 3杯=さんばい); kana teaches a wrong counter reading.
findings.current: かっぷに、こーひーをすぷーんいちばいいれます
findings.suggested: かっぷに、こーひーをすぷーんいっぱいいれます

findings.issue: Romaji mirrors the wrong kana: スプーン1杯 is supu-n ippai, not ichibai.
Token １ before 杯 must read いっ (１杯 = いっぱい); いち is wrong in this context.
Counter 杯 after １ reads ぱい (h→p after sokuon: いっぱい); ばい is the reading after ３ (さんばい), wrong here.
２つ is read ふたつ, not ふつつ; kana teaches a nonexistent reading of the native counter.
findings.current: わたしがふつつのそふとをしょうかいします
findings.suggested: わたしがふたつのそふとをしょうかいします

findings.issue: Romaji mirrors the wrong kana: ２つ is futatsu, not futsutsu.
Numeral ２ before counter つ reads ふた (２つ = ふたつ); ふつ is wrong.
２０ in ベスト２０ is read にじゅう (twenty); にれい reads the digits separately ('two-zero') and is wrong.
findings.current: べすとにれいをしょうかいします
findings.suggested: べすとにじゅうをしょうかいします

findings.issue: Romaji mirrors the wrong kana: ベスト２０ is besuto nijuu, not nirei.
Token ２０ must read にじゅう (twenty); にれい ('two-zero') is not a valid reading of the number 20 here.
'tudo direitinho' adds content absent from jp (必ずチェックを入れる says nothing about 'everything/properly'), and the colloquial diminutive sits oddly with the polite ます register.
